aten.unflatten.int.reason: a view: it splits one dimension into several, which ttnn.reshape does (decomposed to aten.view.default, whose ttnn name is reshape)
aten.unflatten.int.evidence: docs/run-logs/2026-11-02-qwen4-ops-probe.md: the gated residual (hyper-connection) built from ttnn ops with ttnn.reshape matched the reference, mixed output PCC 0.99996 and injection weights PCC 0.9995. The ops come from the attn_hyper_connection, mlp_hyper_connection and ple modules. The ple module was not run on its own

aten.eye.default.reason: a constant: the identity matrix that the chunked gated delta rule adds to its triangular system. ttnn.transformer.chunk_gated_delta_rule takes optional eye, tril, ones and mask constants, which the host can build once and pass in
aten.eye.default.evidence: transformers 5.19.0 modeling_qwen4_exp.py (the GDN chunk path, torch.eye(chunk_size)); docs/run-logs/2026-11-02-qwen4-ops-probe.md ran chunk_gated_delta_rule without the constants and matched the reference (PCC at least 0.99998). Passing the constants was not tried

aten.cummax.default.reason: the EOS-aware shift of the n-gram embedding. ttnn 0.80.0 has no cummax. The upstream port runs the token hash, this shift and the lookup in the 102 GB embedding table on the host
aten.cummax.default.evidence: transformers 5.19.0 modeling_qwen4_exp.py (torch.cummax over EOS positions); docs/run-logs/2026-11-02-qwen4-new-ops.md (n-gram embedding row). The trace places it in the ple_embedding module

aten.diff.default.reason: attention-mask preparation, which is not model math. It finds the boundaries of packed sequences from position_ids, an integer input, on the host before the device runs. It is device-relevant only if serving packs several sequences into one batch row; then the host must build the mask that implies
aten.diff.default.evidence: transformers 5.19.0 masking_utils.py, find_packed_sequence_indices (torch.diff of position_ids), reached from create_causal_mask, which Qwen4ExpModel calls at the top level. The trace places it in the top-level module

aten.histc.default.reason: part of the reference expert loop (count tokens per expert, sort, run grouped matmuls). The device path replaces the whole mlp.experts module with ttnn.experimental.moe_compute, so this op is not built from ttnn ops. See the moe_experts group, which is not verified
